source_semantics: Directory/tenant contains local identity objects and service principals
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains users groups apps service principals devices policies; scopes local object IDs
semantic_risk: Not IdentityContext

source_semantics: Global/home-tenant application definition created by app registration
important_relations_or_lifecycle: referenced by tenant-local service principals; declares app roles/permissions/redirects
semantic_risk: Application object is a managed representation/configuration, not the executing software instance

source_semantics: Local representation/application instance of an application in a tenant; defines what app can do and access
important_relations_or_lifecycle: references application object; receives role/app assignments; authenticates/acts as principal
cm4di_target: CM4DI-C3004 ServicePrincipal; C0025 Principal; representation relation to Application
semantic_risk: Do not equate with Application or workload process

source_semantics: Service principal type created/managed by Azure; no associated application object for managed identity
important_relations_or_lifecycle: platform manages credentials; assigned roles; used by Azure resource/workload
semantic_risk: Managed identity is not generic DigitalIdentity and is not an Application object

source_semantics: Directory user object that can authenticate and receive assignments
important_relations_or_lifecycle: belongs to tenant; groups; roles; app roles; sessions/authentication methods
cm4di_target: C1001 Account; C1002 UserProfile; C0025 Principal
semantic_risk: Not real-world IdentitySubject

source_semantics: Directory group aggregates users/devices/service principals depending group type and can receive assignments
important_relations_or_lifecycle: has members; assigned roles/app roles/resource access
cm4di_target: C1019 AccessGroup when access-oriented; W3C ORG bridge for organization semantics
semantic_risk: Not every Entra group is merely access group

source_semantics: Application-defined role/permission assignable to user/group/service principal
important_relations_or_lifecycle: defined by resource application; assignment emitted in roles claim
semantic_risk: Not UFO Role; exact granularity varies by app role definition

source_semantics: Assignment of app role from resource service principal to user/group/client service principal
important_relations_or_lifecycle: principal receives app role for resource; create/remove lifecycle
semantic_risk: Not runtime AuthorizationResult

source_semantics: Microsoft Entra admin role definition containing allowed directory actions
important_relations_or_lifecycle: assigned to principal at scope
semantic_risk: Not application AppRole and not UFO Role

source_semantics: Resource linking security principal to role definition at scope
important_relations_or_lifecycle: created to grant access; removed to revoke; has principal/role/scope
semantic_risk: Role assignment is durable relation not authorization decision

source_semantics: App-only permission exposed as app role by resource application
important_relations_or_lifecycle: assigned to client service principal; used for app-only access
semantic_risk: Do not conflate permission definition with assignment/consent

source_semantics: Permission exercised by app on behalf of signed-in user within delegated context
important_relations_or_lifecycle: consented; represented in scopes; requires user/delegated context
cm4di_target: C0028 Permission; C0030 Delegation; C0029 AccessGrant
semantic_risk: Delegated permission is not identical to application permission

source_semantics: Directory object recording delegated permission consent between client, resource and optionally principal
important_relations_or_lifecycle: grants scopes; tenant/user consent; lifecycle create/revoke
semantic_risk: Consent record/grant differs from Permission itself

source_semantics: Policy evaluates identity/resource/context/risk/device conditions and enforces controls
important_relations_or_lifecycle: targets users/workloads/agents/resources; applies conditions; grants/blocks/session controls
semantic_risk: Policy engine semantics broader than Core Authorization

source_semantics: Device represented in directory and used in authentication/conditional access
important_relations_or_lifecycle: registered/joined; compliant/risk state; associated users; can be targeted by policy
semantic_risk: Directory object is not physical device itself

source_semantics: Reusable blueprint whose tenant-local blueprint principal creates and manages agent identities
important_relations_or_lifecycle: one blueprint to many agents; protocol properties inherited by agents
semantic_risk: Blueprint is not agent identity instance and not sponsor

source_semantics: Service principal representing blueprint in tenant and managing agent identities
important_relations_or_lifecycle: obtains app-only token; creates/manages agent identities
semantic_risk: Management principal differs from individual agent identity

source_semantics: Single-tenant service principal with agent subtype and agent-specific delegation/audit behavior
important_relations_or_lifecycle: ParentID links blueprint; has sponsor; permissions direct/inherited; tokens issued on behalf of agent; audited distinctly
cm4di_target: C3017 AgentIdentity; C3004 ServicePrincipal; C0025 Principal
semantic_risk: AgentIdentity is not AIAgent software entity itself

source_semantics: Assigned sponsor/accountability relationship for agent identity
important_relations_or_lifecycle: sponsor required/associated; lifecycle/accountability governance
semantic_risk: Sponsor is contextual governance role not owner/equality

source_semantics: Agent identity inherits protocol properties/delegated permission baseline from parent blueprint
important_relations_or_lifecycle: one-to-many parent-child relation; supports token exchange/impersonation lifecycle
semantic_risk: Not class-subclass relation; model as managed provenance/templating relation

source_semantics: Blueprint obtains tokens on behalf of agent identity; resulting token/audit represents agent
important_relations_or_lifecycle: parent blueprint performs exchange; agent is acting client; supports autonomous/delegated modes
semantic_risk: Technical impersonation must not mean identity equality

source_semantics: Agent identity may inherit delegated permissions from blueprint baseline
important_relations_or_lifecycle: permission inheritance plus direct assignment; affects effective authority
semantic_risk: Inheritance is authorization configuration not ontological specialization

source_semantics: Conditional Access can target agent identities with distinct autonomous/on-behalf-of scenarios
important_relations_or_lifecycle: targets agent/resource; evaluates signals; enforces access controls
semantic_risk: Agent policy targeting validates AgentIdentity as Principal, not new Core authorization model
